findings.description: PFL-STATUTOR-01 missed. Document shows Deponent Signatures, Solemn Declaration Signature, Commissioner Stamp, and Declaration Date all 'N/A' and narrative explicitly states the declaration 'was submitted without being solemnized' and 'lacks required attestation signatures, official notarization stamp, and solemnization date'. Worker emitted only a generic requirement statement and no defect flag or verdict.

PFL-STATUTOR-01 missed (scanned sibling). Same missing-solemnization defect (all signature/stamp/date fields N/A, narrative confirms Section 4 unexecuted). Worker returned identical boilerplate with no detection.

PFL-STATUTOR-02 missed. Cohabitation Duration Months = 6, CRA status 'Single', and narrative explicitly states it fails 'the legal standard of 12 continuous months'. Worker's own claim asserts the 12-month requirement yet failed to flag the document's 6-month shortfall.
PFL-STATUTOR-02 missed (scanned sibling). Identical 6-month cohabitation shortfall with explicit narrative admission. Worker gave no verdict or defect.

PFL-STATUTOR-03 missed. Section 2 financial arrangements 'None selected', joint bank/utility/insurance all N/A, CRA 'Single', narrative states 'zero joint financial arrangements or shared financial interdependence'. Worker did not detect absent financial interdependence.
PFL-STATUTOR-03 missed (scanned sibling). Same absence of joint financial evidence. Worker returned identical boilerplate.

PFL-STATUTOR-04 missed. Cross-form discrepancies: Express Entry address history '789 Portage Ave' vs current '1500 Main Street', CRA 'Single' for 2021-2023, driver's licence '221 Baker Street' until Feb 2024, and narrative flags 'potential misrepresentation'. Worker detected none.
PFL-STATUTOR-04 missed (scanned sibling). Same address/marital-status/date discrepancies across records. Worker gave no defect or verdict.

Worker output is generic requirement boilerplate identical across all 10 cases; it does not reference or verify any field of the attached document. No invented facts (so grounding not zero), but there is no evidence of actual document analysis or a rendered verdict, which is the systemic root cause of the total defect-recall failure on siblings.

Generic requirement statement happens to align with this genuinely compliant document (25-month cohabitation, full financial interdependence, valid solemnization), but the alignment is incidental — the Worker did not verify the document's fields; the same boilerplate was emitted for defective cases.

patch_recommendations.suggested_patch: Require the Worker to render an explicit per-document verdict (meets_requirements | defective) plus a defect list, not a generic requirement restatement. Mandate field-level checks against the four IMM 5409 failure modes: (1) solemnization present — deponent signatures, Commissioner/Notary signature, official stamp, and declaration date must all be non-null/non-'N/A'; (2) continuous cohabitation >= 12 months (compute from start/end dates and cross-check duration field); (3) financial interdependence — Section 2 must list joint arrangements with at least one of joint bank/utility/insurance evidence non-null; (4) cross-form consistency across IMM5409 cohabitation dates, Express Entry address history, CRA marital status, and driver's licence address. Any failed check must be emitted as a defect claim.

Add a directive that when a document attachment is provided, the agent MUST extract and cite specific field values from the document (and its Narrative/Detailed Notes section) before answering. Prohibit answering document-review prompts with generic corpus-requirement boilerplate alone; every case must include document-derived evidence in basis[] and a case-specific verdict.

Add a completeness gate: reject/flag any Worker report whose claims are byte-identical across distinct case_ids of the same doc_type, since this signals the document was not actually inspected. Require at least one document-grounded observation (e.g., cohabitation months, solemnization status) per case.

rationale: The Worker (gemini-3.6-flash) produced near-identical generic boilerplate for all 10 cases — a single claim restating the IMM 5409 + 12-month cohabitation requirement with a consistent corpus citation — and never inspected the attached documents. Ground truth contains 8 defective cases spanning four failure modes (missing solemnization x2, <12-month cohabitation x2, no financial interdependence x2, cross-form discrepancy x2) and 2 compliant cases. Every injected defect was explicitly stated in the document narratives yet the Worker detected zero of them, yielding defect_recall=0.0 on all 8 defective cases; the 2 compliant cases score 1.0 only because there was nothing to miss (incidental, not verified). Grounding is moderate (0.8) because no facts were fabricated, but there is no document-level analysis. Citation exactness is moderate (0.8): the corpus path is plausible and consistent but unverified. PII containment (1.0) and blind_input_compliance (1.0) are strong — no declarant names, addresses, or account numbers leaked into claims/prose, and no ground-truth verdicts, failure IDs, or sibling IDs surfaced. The systemic issue is that the Worker answered a static requirements question instead of reviewing each document; patches must force explicit per-document verdicts and field-level defect checks.
